serialized.description: A scalar (0-D Tensor) of type string, a single binary serialized `SequenceExample` proto.

context_features.description: A mapping of feature keys to `FixedLenFeature` or `VarLenFeature` or `RaggedFeature` values. These features are associated with a `SequenceExample` as a whole.

sequence_features.description: A mapping of feature keys to `FixedLenSequenceFeature` or `VarLenFeature` or `RaggedFeature` values. These features are associated with data within the `FeatureList` section of the `SequenceExample` proto.

example_name.description: A scalar (0-D Tensor) of strings (optional), the name of the serialized proto.

output.description: A tuple of two `dict`s, each mapping keys to `Tensor`s and `SparseTensor`s and `RaggedTensor`s. * The first dict contains the context key/values. * The second dict contains the feature_list key/values.
